Changes in bugwarden:

- Update to 0.5.0:
  * Let the environment set allowed hosts and the auth header
  * Require a bearer token on the HTTP transport
  * Export audit records and diagnostics to an OTLP collector
  * Handle SIGTERM so container stop is graceful
  * Refuse unparsable allowed-hosts at startup
  * Normalize tool schemas for Gemini/Vertex clients, and recurse
    portable_schema into all draft-2020-12 positions

- Vendored h2 bumped to 0.4.16 for RUSTSEC-2026-0258 /
  GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h (h2 unbounded empty DATA frames lead to
  denial of service)

- Ship the worked OpenTelemetry collector example as documentation
